basic_info.description: Hot Mission District Mixed Use Investment Property  This asset consists of 3 Spacious Residential Flats and a Corner Commercial Unit.  The commercial is an elegant Restaurant Use with an Experienced Operator providing Stability for the property.  There is a Huge and Bright Top Floor Flat that is Vacant, which could appeal to an Owner Occupier.  This Flat has been leased out as a 4 Bedroom, but is more traditionally a 3 Bedroom with 1 and  Bathrooms.  The other Two Flats have similar style usage and have their entrances on the 20th Street side of the building.  There are basement storage rooms that could be leased for storage or have ADU potential.  Situated on a wide lot, this is Opportunity!!!
